title: NATIVE ON build, tier 1: present path (Agent 7: n0 a1 d0 d1) and draw path (Agent 4: t1 t2). Title/attract loop, no input needed
notes: BIN DIR: build/agent2/native-bin (S1 + p1 perf.csv rows + p2 Plume GPU_UPLOAD cast + Agent 6's N1 inputs; staged by Agent 2 at 21:48; exe sha256 3B329E9550A1178C...). Every arm runs the same exe; only the environment differs.

Frame times: native-frames.csv (frames=native makes the runner set LEGO_NATIVE_FRAME_METRICS; one buffered row per present, the same cost in every arm). native-bin also has Agent 7's perf.csv-rows patch, so perf.csv rows should be about equal to presents (check after the first run).
No LEGO_NATIVE_TIMING, LEGO_NATIVE_STATE_CALLS or debug layer in any timing arm (Agents 4 and 7). Agent 4's optional T3 (t1 and t2 together) is not in this file.
Groups: 'present' compares a1 with n0; 'pacing' compares d1 with d0; 'draw' compares t1 and t2 with n0 (the top-level reference; Agent 4's T0 is n0).
Warm-up is 30 s after the first frame (Agent 7: first frame + 30 s once the native boot time is known).
Per-arm repeats: Agent 4 asks for 5 runs of n0/t1/t2; Agent 7 asks for at least 3 (5 preferred).
Agent 4's threaded arms th1-th3 are in matrix-native-threaded.json; tiers 2 and 3 of Agent 7 are in matrix-native-tier2.json and matrix-native-tier3.json.
After the matrix: python bench\agent7\native_frames_summary.py <run dirs of n0 a1 d0 d1> for Agent 7.

arms.note: Agent 7 n0 = Agent 4 T0: new defaults ((a),(b),(c) on), VSync off, cap 240. Check game.log 'display gamma updated ... identity='
Agent 7 a1: the old present path. Expect n0 >= a1 (fps, p50, p99, cores)
Agent 7 d0: 60 fps limiter, VSync off. Check 'presentation cap override=60' and native_vsync=0 in the last CSV row
Agent 7 d1: limiter sleep outside the recording gate. Mean fps within 0.5% of d0; sd and p99 no worse. Check 'unlocked frame pacing margin=2000us'
Agent 4 T1: state-call elision (B3). A win only if it beats n0 by more than n0's spread, with no new warnings
Agent 4 T2: plume command state cache (reported on stderr only)
